text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! There're so many different vehicles!
The big city really is somethin' else, ain't it?!
Since Yukino Bijin said she wanted to experience a big-city amusement park, we came out to have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There're so many people, it feels just like a festival!
Well I'll be, color me amazed~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Sounds noisy over there...
Could it be a popular ride, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text: "Don't dodge the question! Truth is, you really want to return to the racing world, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Actor B
text_block_list.text:
"Even after coming all the way out here, you're still talking about racing?!
...Don't just go assuming how other people feel!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Trainer!!
Are they filming a drama over there!?
There are so many actors from TV, by golly!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Amazin'...! Celebrities sparkle so much more in person than on TV...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Her looks and gestures are gorgeous, sure, but that ain't all.
She's confident, and throwin' her whole heart into the role...
into becoming the person she wants to be!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's so radiant, I can't take my eyes off it...
Even from afar,
it steals away your eyes and your heart in an instant...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Those people are such awesome "city girls"!
I hope that someday... I can be one too...
Yukino Bijin's eyes sparkled with a look entirely different from her earlier excitement.
choice_data_list: Do you want to be in a drama too, Yukino?
Would you like to be in a drama too, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-Well yeah,
I wanna be someone who can captivate people
with my looks and personality just like them...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I could stand on the same stage and perform with her,
I feel like I'd get way closer to becoming a strong, cool "City Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still... for plain ol' me, that's probably just a pipe dream. Ahaha...

Yukino Bijin looks apologetic,
but the words she muttered earlier linger in my mind.

"I want to, too... someday..."
Is that wish truly so distant?
Can I really not get even a little bit closer?
For instance, if it's a role with few appearances and lines, appearing in it shouldn't be difficult—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
Yukino's Trainer, I brought what you asked for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What you asked for...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. They asked me if there were any minor roles
in a drama that Yukino could audition for.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I picked out a few options for now, so could you look over them with me, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I'd recommend the schoolgirl at the end.
It's easier to play a role that feels relatable, right?"
choice_data_list: True, this looks like it'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat!?
W-W-W-Wait for me, please!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A drama, wait, what!?
Me!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You want to be in it, don't you? The drama.
I know you can do it, Yukino."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! No way, no way!
I mean, sure, I'm interested, but...
I-I'm nowhere near good enough for that!
choice_data_list: That's not true! You can definitely do it, Yukino!
I'd love to see Yukino act in a drama.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure...?
choice_data_list: You always give your all to everything, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Acting isn't just about flashy looks.
It's a world where quiet, steady effort actually makes all the difference.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's why I think Yukino has the aptitude for it, though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
City-san...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want to give it a try...! I want to be in a drama, act super cool, and take things to the next level...!!

And so, a promise was made that if the chance
to perform ever came, she would give it everything she had.
Having made up her mind, Yukino Bijin's eyes burned with determination.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What?!
No way...!
choice_data_list: It's definitely going to be an amazing story!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino always says stuff like, "Someone like me..."
but personally, I think she's pretty cool.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Have a little faith in what an active model has to say, would you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawa, hawawa...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think a "City Girl" also needs
confidence and experience, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I can't let myself get intimidated if I want to become a fine "City Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want to be in the drama!
I'll do my very, very best so I don't let
either of you down...!

And so, a promise was made that if the chance
to perform ever came, she would give it everything she had.

Yukino Bijin plucked up her courage,
determined to take on a brand-new challenge.
